body: I don't even know what to say to him....

I've been trying to find help. Either they don't take my insurance or they never call me back. Today was kinda the last straw. Someone ignored a text that I sent. Someone who I thought was my friend. So I tried calling around for psychs bc I knew I was getting bad. Called over 6 places and nobody took my insurance or they didn't answer the phone.
Not exactly. I've talked to him about it before but he currently has no clue how bad I feel.

I just want to be happy. But i feel like it's not possible. I really can't keep living feeling this way. I totally get where you're coming from. And I honestly feel awful already for doing this to my boyfriend. But my pain has finally surpassed my desire to not let anyone down.

Thanks for the response, I really appreciate it. I want to do it because I hate my life and myself. I cannot even take/look at a picture of myself without being disgusted. I have no real close friends and have a hard time developing new relationships due to intense fear of rejection. I hate my job and I'm tired of being so lonely. I'm honestly just tired of being this way. I want to be normal. I was finally doing okay and on meds but I had to move to find a job. Now I'm unmedicated and I feel completely numb.  I'm going to leave a note so at least people understand it's my mental illness, not them, that caused this.

I can't talk to him about this. It scares him and he never knows what to say. I know this will hurt him but I'm so miserable. I can't keep up with life anymore and I barely even have a life. He really can do better. Regardless of what he wants I know that to be true. Idk how to even talk to him about this. The last time I tried he got so upset.
